Third-party library

This component is an adapter for {{.Package}} ({{.License}} license). velle-css does not ship or bundle it, and it is not part of dist/velle.js. Install version {{.Version}} (the version the adapter is tested against) in one of these ways:

With a bundler

npm install {{.Package}}@{{.Version}}
{{if .Stylesheet}}

Then import {{.Package}}/{{.Stylesheet}} before {{$.Component.Name}}.css, so velle's theme overrides the library's defaults.

{{end}}

Without a build step

Map the package name to a CDN build in an import map, placed before any module script:

{{$.Component.ImportMapEntry}}{{if .Stylesheet}}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{{.StylesheetURL}}"> <!-- before {{$.Component.Name}}.css -->{{end}}

When you use the dist/velle.js bundle, load the adapter from dist/adapters/: those copies share the bundle's runtime.

{{end}}{{end}}
